description: DSC Orchestrator compliance, drift, enforcement, and bootstrap status for managed VM groups. Uses DscOrchestrator Log Analytics tables and Azure Resource Graph.

panels.title: Total VMs

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let scoped = DscOrchestrator_Runs_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where group in (${group:singlequote})
| where role in~ (${role:singlequote})
| where config_version in (${config_version:singlequote})
| where Computer in (${vm:singlequote});
scoped
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Computer
| extend State = case(had_errors == true, 'Errored', coalesce(non_compliant_count, 0) > 0, 'Non-Compliant', coalesce(compliant_resources, 0) > 0, 'Compliant', coalesce(skipped_count, 0) > 0, 'Skipped', coalesce(unevaluated_count, 0) > 0, 'Not Evaluated', 'Unknown')
| where (isempty('${compliance_state:raw}') or '${compliance_state:raw}' == 'All' or State == '${compliance_state:raw}')
| summarize Value=dcount(Computer)

panels.description: Distinct VMs reporting DSC Orchestrator runs in the selected time window.

panels.title: % Compliant

panels.title: % Compliant VMs Over Time

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let bucketSize = 1h;
DscOrchestrator_Runs_CL
| where TimeGenerated <= $__timeTo() and TimeGenerated >= datetime_add('day', -1, $__timeFrom())
| where group in (${group:singlequote})
| where role in~ (${role:singlequote})
| where config_version in (${config_version:singlequote})
| where Computer in (${vm:singlequote})
| extend State = case(had_errors == true, 'Errored', coalesce(non_compliant_count, 0) > 0, 'Non-Compliant', coalesce(compliant_resources, 0) > 0, 'Compliant', coalesce(skipped_count, 0) > 0, 'Skipped', coalesce(unevaluated_count, 0) > 0, 'Not Evaluated', 'Unknown')
| where (isempty('${compliance_state:raw}') or '${compliance_state:raw}' == 'All' or State == '${compliance_state:raw}')
| extend StateInt = case(State == 'Compliant', 1, State in ('Non-Compliant', 'Errored'), 0, -1)
| where StateInt >= 0
| summarize Latest = max(StateInt) by bin(TimeGenerated, bucketSize), Computer
| make-series LatestSeries = max(Latest) default=long(null) on TimeGenerated from $__timeFrom() to $__timeTo() step bucketSize by Computer
| extend LatestSeries = series_fill_forward(LatestSeries)
| mv-expand TimeGenerated to typeof(datetime), LatestSeries to typeof(long)
| where isnotnull(LatestSeries)
| summarize Total = count(), Compliant = countif(LatestSeries == 1) by TimeGenerated
| extend ['% Compliant'] = iif(Total > 0, 100.0 * Compliant / Total, 0.0)
| project TimeGenerated, ['% Compliant']
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.description: Share of VMs in 'Compliant' state per hour, applied to the current Group / VM filter. Each VM's last-known state is carried forward into any bucket where it didn't run, so missed reports don't produce spikes.

panels.title: % Compliant Resources Over Time

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let bucketSize = 1h;
DscOrchestrator_Runs_CL
| where TimeGenerated <= $__timeTo() and TimeGenerated >= datetime_add('day', -1, $__timeFrom())
| where group in (${group:singlequote})
| where role in~ (${role:singlequote})
| where config_version in (${config_version:singlequote})
| where Computer in (${vm:singlequote})
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, compliant_resources, non_compliant_count) by bin(TimeGenerated, bucketSize), Computer
| project bucketTime = bin(TimeGenerated, bucketSize), Computer, Comp = compliant_resources, Failing = non_compliant_count
| make-series Comp = max(Comp), Failing = max(Failing) default=long(null) on bucketTime from $__timeFrom() to $__timeTo() step bucketSize by Computer
| extend Comp = series_fill_forward(Comp, long(null)), Failing = series_fill_forward(Failing, long(null))
| mv-expand bucketTime to typeof(datetime), Comp to typeof(long), Failing to typeof(long)
| where isnotnull(Comp)
| summarize Comp = sum(Comp), Failing = sum(Failing) by bucketTime
| extend ['% Compliant'] = iif((Comp + Failing) > 0, 100.0 * Comp / (Comp + Failing), 0.0)
| project TimeGenerated = bucketTime, ['% Compliant']
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.description: Resource-level compliance % per hour. Same math as the 'Overall Resource Compliance' gauge above, plotted over time with carry-forward per (VM, resource) so the line is stable when state is stable.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let scoped = DscOrchestrator_Runs_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where group in (${group:singlequote})
| where role in~ (${role:singlequote})
| where config_version in (${config_version:singlequote})
| where Computer in (${vm:singlequote});
scoped
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Computer
| extend State = case(had_errors == true, 'Errored', coalesce(non_compliant_count, 0) > 0, 'Non-Compliant', coalesce(compliant_resources, 0) > 0, 'Compliant', coalesce(skipped_count, 0) > 0, 'Skipped', coalesce(unevaluated_count, 0) > 0, 'Not Evaluated', 'Unknown')
| where (isempty('${compliance_state:raw}') or '${compliance_state:raw}' == 'All' or State == '${compliance_state:raw}')
| extend errj = parse_json(error)
| extend error_summary = coalesce(tostring(errj.summary), error)
| extend first_failure = iff(array_length(errj.failures) > 0, errj.failures[0], dynamic(null))
| extend first_fail_desc = iff(isnotnull(first_failure), strcat(tostring(first_failure.fragment), '/', tostring(first_failure.phase), ' ', tostring(first_failure.type), '/', tostring(first_failure.name)), '')
| extend first_err = iff(array_length(erroring_resources) > 0, erroring_resources[0], dynamic(null))
| extend failing_resource_type = tostring(first_err.type), failing_resource_message = tostring(first_err.message)
| project Computer, ['Group'] = group, ['Last Run'] = TimeGenerated, State, Outcome = outcome, Resources = total_resources, ['Non-Compliant'] = non_compliant_count, Errors = had_errors, ['Error Summary'] = error_summary, ['First Failure'] = first_fail_desc, Duration = total_duration, Mode = mode, Trigger = trigger
| order by State asc, ['Non-Compliant'] desc

value.title: Open full resource log for this run

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let completed = DscOrchestrator_Runs_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| distinct run_id;
DscOrchestrator_Resources_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where group in (${group:singlequote})
| where role in~ (${role:singlequote})
| where config_version in (${config_version:singlequote})
| where Computer in (${vm:singlequote})
| where run_id !in (completed)
| summarize Started=min(TimeGenerated), arg_max(TimeGenerated, resource_type, resource_name, phase, event, in_desired_state, had_errors) by run_id, Computer, group, config_version
| extend ['Age (min)'] = toint(datetime_diff('minute', now(), TimeGenerated))
| extend ['Current Resource'] = strcat(case(event == 'start', 'remediating: ', event == 'end', 'remediated: ', in_desired_state == false, 'drifted: ', 'testing: '), resource_type, '/', resource_name)
| project VM=Computer, ['Group']=group, ['Config Version']=config_version, Started, ['Age (min)'], ['Current Resource'], Phase=phase, run_id
| order by Started desc

| order by State desc, ['Last Seen'] desc

panels.description: Per-VM resource detail with reasons, bound to each VM's latest DSC Orchestrator run inside the selected Group / VM / Config Version context. VM identity is (group, Computer), not Computer alone, so the same VM name appearing in two selected Groups keeps a separate latest run and a separate set of rows for each pool instead of one pool's run silently displacing the other's. One row per Group x Computer x run_id x resource_type x resource_name (latest test OR verify record), so repeated telemetry events for the same resource do not duplicate. The join to the latest-run set is on group, Computer and run_id, and the duplicate right-hand key columns it produces are projected away immediately, so no ambiguous group column reaches the output. Also scoped by Resource Type / Fragment / Compliance State. Phase shows whether the row came from a pre-set test or a post-set verify; verify rows are the authoritative post-remediation state when present. Module is the DSC adapter hosting the resource. Enforcement ID comes from the latest run, because DscOrchestrator_Resources_CL does not carry that column. If a VM's latest run emitted only a summary row, that VM contributes no rows here.

panels.title: Recent Errored Runs (DSC Orchestrator run-level)

value.title: Investigate this run (sets Run ID variable)

azureLogAnalytics.query:
DscOrchestrator_Runs_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where group in (${group:singlequote})
| where role in~ (${role:singlequote})
| where config_version in (${config_version:singlequote})
| where Computer in (${vm:singlequote})
| where had_errors == true
| extend errj = parse_json(error)
| extend error_summary = coalesce(tostring(errj.summary), error)
| extend diagnostic_text = strcat(error_summary, ' ', tostring(erroring_resources))
| extend error_class = case(diagnostic_text contains 'module not found', 'module_not_found', diagnostic_text contains 'timeout' or diagnostic_text contains 'timed out', 'timeout', diagnostic_text contains 'JSON parse', 'json_parse', diagnostic_text contains 'drift persisted', 'drift_persisted', 'unknown')
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, ['Group'] = group, Outcome = outcome, error_class, ['Exit Code'] = exit_code, RunId = run_id, Error = error_summary, ['Non-Compliant'] = non_compliant_count
| order by TimeGenerated desc

panels.description: DscOrchestrator_Runs_CL rows where had_errors=true or error is non-empty. Click a RunId to set the Run ID variable — both the Module Log Errors table (below) and the Full Trace panel further down will filter to that run.

panels.title: Skipped Fragments (dependency gate)

value.title: Investigate this run (sets Run ID variable)

azureLogAnalytics.query:
DscOrchestrator_Resources_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where group in (${group:singlequote})
| where role in~ (${role:singlequote})
| where config_version in (${config_version:singlequote})
| where Computer in (${vm:singlequote})
| where result == 'skipped'
| extend errj = parse_json(error_message)
| where tostring(errj.tag) == 'fragment_skipped'
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, error_message, group) by run_id, Computer, fragment
| extend errj = parse_json(error_message)
| mv-expand d = errj.blockedByDetail
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, ['Group'] = group, Fragment = fragment, ['Blocked By'] = tostring(d.name), Status = tostring(d.status), Reason = tostring(errj.reason), RunId = run_id
| order by TimeGenerated desc

panels.description: Fragments skipped by the cross-fragment dependency gate because a dependency did not reach strict success. One row per blocking dependency, with its terminal Status (failed / non_compliant / unevaluated / skipped). Sourced from parse_json(error_message).blockedByDetail[] on the 'skipped' resource rows in DscOrchestrator_Resources_CL. Click a RunId to pivot the run-scoped panels to that run.

panels.title: Drift Reasons (why is this resource non-compliant?)

value.title: Filter Module Log Errors + Full Trace to this resource

azureLogAnalytics.query:
DscOrchestrator_Resources_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where group in (${group:singlequote})
| where role in~ (${role:singlequote})
| where config_version in (${config_version:singlequote})
| where Computer in (${vm:singlequote})
| where phase == 'verify'
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Computer, resource_type, resource_name
| where in_desired_state == false
| mv-expand r = reasons
| extend ['Reason Code'] = tostring(r.code), ['Reason Phrase'] = tostring(r.phrase)
| project Computer, ['Fragment'] = coalesce(fragment, '(unknown)'), ['Resource Name'] = resource_name, ['Resource Type'] = resource_type, ['Reason Code'], ['Reason Phrase'], ['Last Seen'] = TimeGenerated
| order by ['Last Seen'] desc

panels.description: Structured reason from DSC Orchestrator Test phase, one row per (VM, resource, reason). Tells you WHY the resource isn't in desired state. Click a Resource Name cell to filter the Module Log Errors / Full Trace panels below to logs about that resource (contains-match against app_context or message).

panels.title: Run Resource Log (chronological, all events)

azureLogAnalytics.query:
DscOrchestrator_Resources_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where run_id == '${run_id}'
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Phase=phase, Event=event, Action=action, Fragment=coalesce(fragment, '(unknown)'), ['Resource Type']=resource_type, ['Resource Name']=resource_name, ['In Desired State']=in_desired_state, ['Had Errors']=had_errors, Result=result, Reasons=tostring(reasons), ['Error Message']=error_message, Duration=duration
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.description: Full chronological per-event resource log for the run_id set in the variable -- every test/set/verify event row from DscOrchestrator_Resources_CL, oldest first (no dedup). Reached from the run_id link in Currently Running Enforcements. Empty when no Run ID is set.

panels.title: Recent Module Log Errors & Warnings (VM-side)

value.title: Investigate this run (sets Run ID variable)

azureLogAnalytics.query:
DscOrchestrator_ModuleLogs_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where level in ('Error', 'Warning')
| extend ShortComputer = extract(@"^([^.]+)", 1, Computer)
| where ShortComputer in (${vm:singlequote})
| where '${run_id}' == '' or run_id == '${run_id}'
| where '${resource}' == '' or app_context contains '${resource}' or message contains '${resource}'
| extend LevelPriority = case(level == 'Error', 0, 1)
| extend MessageClean = replace_regex(replace_regex(message, @"[ \\/|\-]{4,}", " "), @"\s{2,}", " ")
| project TimeGenerated, VM=ShortComputer, Level=level, Module=module_name, Function=function_name, Context=app_context, RunId=run_id, Message=MessageClean, LevelPriority
| order by LevelPriority asc, TimeGenerated desc
| project-away LevelPriority

panels.description: Module error and warning rows. This panel requires module log collection to be enabled.

panels.title: Full Trace for Run ID (paste/click run_id above)

| where '${resource}' == '' or app_context contains '${resource}' or message contains '${resource}'
| extend MessageClean = replace_regex(replace_regex(message, @"[ \\/|\-]{4,}", " "), @"\s{2,}", " ")
| project TimeGenerated, Level=level, Module=module_name, Function=function_name, Context=app_context, Message=MessageClean

panels.description: Module error and warning rows. This panel requires module log collection to be enabled.

panels.title: Slowest Resources (all phases)

azureLogAnalytics.query:
DscOrchestrator_Resources_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where group in (${group:singlequote})
| where role in~ (${role:singlequote})
| where config_version in (${config_version:singlequote})
| where Computer in (${vm:singlequote})
| where isnotempty(duration)
| extend _H = todouble(coalesce(extract(@"PT([\d.]+)H", 1, duration), "0"))
| extend _M = todouble(coalesce(extract(@"H([\d.]+)M", 1, duration), extract(@"PT([\d.]+)M", 1, duration), "0"))
| extend _S = todouble(coalesce(extract(@"M([\d.]+)S", 1, duration), extract(@"H([\d.]+)S", 1, duration), extract(@"PT([\d.]+)S", 1, duration), "0"))
| extend DurSec = _H * 3600 + _M * 60 + _S
| summarize Max=round(max(DurSec), 1), Avg=round(avg(DurSec), 1), P95=round(percentile(DurSec, 95), 1), Runs=count() by Phase=phase, ['Resource Type']=resource_type, ['Resource Name']=resource_name
| order by Max desc

panels.description: Per-resource execution time, all phases (test/set/verify). Sort by Max to find spikes, Avg for consistent offenders. Set phase = install/configure step (this is the slow one).

panels.title: Avg Set Duration by Resource

azureLogAnalytics.query:
DscOrchestrator_Resources_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where group in (${group:singlequote})
| where role in~ (${role:singlequote})
| where config_version in (${config_version:singlequote})
| where Computer in (${vm:singlequote})
| where phase == 'set'
| where isnotempty(duration)
| extend _H = todouble(coalesce(extract(@"PT([\d.]+)H", 1, duration), "0"))
| extend _M = todouble(coalesce(extract(@"H([\d.]+)M", 1, duration), extract(@"PT([\d.]+)M", 1, duration), "0"))
| extend _S = todouble(coalesce(extract(@"M([\d.]+)S", 1, duration), extract(@"H([\d.]+)S", 1, duration), extract(@"PT([\d.]+)S", 1, duration), "0"))
| extend DurSec = _H * 3600 + _M * 60 + _S
| summarize AvgSec=round(avg(DurSec), 1) by Resource=resource_name
| order by AvgSec desc

panels.description: Average duration of the Set phase (install/configure step) per resource. Quickly identifies the worst offenders.

list.name: config_version
list.label: Config Version
list.description:
Filter to one or more DSC Orchestrator config versions. Auto-populated from logs and cascades from the Group and VM selections. Sorted by most-recent activity (newest deployment first). Default All = every version (no restriction).

Filters these panels:
• Overview row: Total VMs, % Compliant, % with Drift, Stale VMs (>1h), Resource Breakdown
• Compliance row: Overall Resource Compliance, Compliance by Resource Type, Compliance by Group
• Trends row: % Compliant VMs Over Time, % Compliant Resources Over Time
• History row: VM Compliance History, Resource Compliance History
• Detail rows: Per-VM Status (Latest Run), Bootstrap Stage History, Top Drifting Resources, Resource Detail
• Diagnostics: Recent Errored Runs, Drift Reasons
• Performance: Slowest Resources, Avg Set Duration by Resource

Does NOT filter (bootstrap/module-log panels — they don't carry config_version): Bootstrap Health, PowerShell 7 Source Distribution, Recent Fatal Bootstrap Rows, Recent Module Log Errors & Warnings, Full Trace for Run ID.
